title: R2 V2X-to-ADA object message
description: One JSON message per perceived-object update, V2X ECU -> ADA ECU over UDP (report section 2 R2). SI units. sender.speed is nullable (F1: derived at the V2X ECU, null until two CPMs from that station arrived). object.distance is derived as hypot(position.x, position.y) in R9 (F7). Unknown extra fields are tolerated for additive evolution.

stationId.description: sender (B) station ID from the CPM

rxTime.description: receive timestamp at the V2X ECU, ms epoch

heading.description: degrees, from CPM orientationAngle (0.1-degree wire units / 10)

speed.description: m/s; null until derived from consecutive reference positions (F1)

objectId.description: B-assigned ID of the perceived object (C)

distance.description: B->C range, m - derived hypot(position.x, position.y) (F7); input to R13 admission

confidence.description: position accuracy in metres (F6 - not a probability)
class confidence 0-1; null when CPM ConfidenceLevel = 101 (F6)
